70.Log:
# Fbsdata
- When a tkmod folder path is set, it warns you if any of your existing mods contain overlapping (duplicate) item IDs.
# Moveset Update
## Animation Manager stability improvements
- Added animation renaming (if you rename to a name that already exists, a _1, _2 suffix is appended).
- Stabilized animation removal (the animation-name dictionary is now kept up to date).
- When adding an animation, if a fully identical one already exists it is skipped.
- When adding an animation that isn't identical but shares the same name, the suffix described above is appended instead.
- When you remove an animation that is still referenced, those references are filled with the debug animation used by move(0).
## Major list-management overhaul
- Fixed an issue where removing the first item of a list broke the references from moves (the list stays valid even when its first item is removed).
- Added per-item Duplicate / Move / Remove buttons (the old "+" button has been retired).
- Added customizable shortcuts for Duplicate / Move / Remove and more (configurable in Settings).
- Added per-section width adjustment for sub-windows (adjusted widths are remembered and restored the next time you open the editor).
- Sub-windows now always come to the front when you click a Go button.
- Improved threading so you can keep several moveset editors open at once.
